init_git_repo: initialize a new Git repository at a given file system path
get_git_status: get the current status of a Git repository showing modified and untracked files
commit_changes: commit staged changes to a Git repository with a provided commit message
create_git_branch: create a new Git branch from the active branch or a specified base branch
get_git_log: get recent commit history from a Git repository with a configurable maximum count
